words.definition: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.
words.example: The main purpose of the meeting is to discuss the new project.

words.definition: A distinctive attribute or aspect of something.
words.example: The best feature of this car is its fuel efficiency.

words.definition: A piece of furniture for sleep or rest, typically a framework with a mattress.
words.example: I was so tired that I went straight to bed after work.

words.definition: Third-person singular present of come.
words.example: She always comes to the office early on Mondays.

words.definition: The civil force of a state, responsible for the prevention and detection of crime and the maintenance of public order.
words.example: The police quickly arrived at the scene of the accident.

words.definition: Every person.
words.example: Everyone enjoyed the delicious food at the party.

words.definition: Free from outside control; not depending on another's authority.

words.definition: Come near or nearer to someone or something in distance or time.

words.definition: Of a color produced by mixing red, yellow, and black.
words.example: He wore a stylish pair of dark brown leather shoes.

words.definition: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind.
words.example: Regular physical exercise is very important for your health.

words.definition: A naturally raised area of land, not as high or craggy as a mountain.

words.definition: A drug or other preparation for the treatment or prevention of disease.

words.definition: An agreement entered into by two or more parties for their mutual benefit.

words.definition: Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

words.definition: Abbreviation for Tuesday.

words.definition: Protected from or not exposed to danger or risk.

words.definition: Being the only one of its kind; unlike anything else.

words.definition: A general view, examination, or description of someone or something.

words.definition: Existing or coming before in time, order, or importance.

words.definition: A system for transmitting voices over a distance using wire or radio.

words.definition: An activity involving physical exertion and skill in which an individual or team competes against another.

words.definition: Give food to.

words.definition: A living organism that feeds on organic matter, typically having specialized sense organs.

words.definition: All the inhabitants of a particular town, area, or country.

words.definition: In a straightforward or plain manner.

words.definition: The available body of facts or information indicating whether a belief or proposition is true or valid.

words.definition: A place or building where a specified activity or service is based.

words.definition: Preferred before all others of the same kind.

words.definition: A thing that is or may be chosen.

words.definition: The red liquid that circulates in the arteries and veins of humans and other vertebrate animals.

words.example: Be careful not to cut your finger while chopping those vegetables.

words.definition: Make or become better.

words.definition: A relationship in which a person, thing, or idea is linked or associated with something else.

words.definition: A person or company that prepares and issues books, journals, or music for sale.
words.example: The author finally found a publisher for her first novel.

words.definition: The room or space just inside the front entrance of a house or flat.
words.example: Please leave your wet umbrella in the front hall.

words.definition: Opposed to; against.
words.example: He is strongly anti-war and attends many peaceful protests.

words.definition: The planet on which we live; the world.
words.example: The earth revolves around the sun once every year.

words.definition: The action of one object coming forcibly into contact with another, or a marked effect or influence.
words.example: The new policies had a huge impact on the local economy.

words.definition: Move from one place to another.

words.definition: The action of introducing something.

words.definition: A room or area where food is prepared and cooked.

words.definition: Having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks.

words.definition: A marriage ceremony, especially considered as including the associated celebrations.

words.definition: An institution providing medical and surgical treatment and nursing care for sick or injured people.
words.example: She works as a nurse at the local city hospital.

words.definition: The solid surface of the earth.

words.definition: A general review or summary of a subject.

words.definition: A room, group of rooms, or building in which someone may live or stay.
words.example: We booked our hotel accommodation months in advance.

words.definition: A disorder of structure or function in a human, animal, or plant.

words.definition: Extremely good; outstanding.

words.definition: Past tense and past participle of pay.

words.definition: Having all the required or desirable elements, qualities, or characteristics; as good as it is possible to be.

words.definition: Any of the fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans, mammals, and some other animals.

words.definition: A set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something.

words.definition: A set of articles or equipment needed for a specific purpose.
words.example: Always keep a first-aid kit in your car for emergencies.

words.definition: Judged over a period of time to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.definition: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

words.definition: To give an authoritative order.
words.example: The general commanded his troops to advance immediately.

words.definition: Convey a thought or feeling in words or by gestures and conduct.
words.example: It is important to express your feelings clearly and honestly.

words.definition: Informal: excessively orderly or fussy.
words.example: He is so anal about keeping his desk perfectly clean.

words.definition: A prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.
words.example: She won an award for being the best actress of the year.

words.definition: The length of the space between two points.
words.example: The distance between the two cities is roughly fifty miles.

words.definition: A woody perennial plant, typically having a single stem or trunk growing to a considerable height.
words.example: We sat in the shade of a large oak tree.

words.definition: A common name for a male.
words.example: Peter is coming over for dinner later tonight.

words.definition: The evaluation or estimation of the nature, quality, or ability of someone or something.

words.definition: Make certain that something shall occur or be the case.

words.definition: As a result or consequence of this; therefore.

words.definition: A continuous vertical brick or stone structure that encloses or divides an area of land.
words.example: They hung a beautiful painting on the living room wall.

words.definition: Connected or concerned with someone or something.
words.example: She was deeply involved in the local charity organization.

words.definition: Added to an existing or usual amount or number.

words.definition: Used to single out one person, thing, or situation over all others.
words.example: She loves all animals, but especially dogs and horses.

words.definition: Informal: a cat.

words.definition: An estimate of income and expenditure for a set period of time.

words.definition: The accomplishment of an aim or purpose.

words.definition: The greatest amount, extent, or intensity possible.

words.definition: An act of surgery performed on a patient.

words.definition: To a certain or fairly significant extent or degree.

words.definition: A male child or young man.

words.definition: A tall, strong, or athletic woman, originally referring to female warriors in Greek mythology.
words.example: She was a fierce amazon on the basketball court.

words.definition: Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically.
words.example: She wore a beautiful dress to the formal gala.

words.definition: A statement or event that indicates a possible or impending danger, problem, or other unpleasant situation.
words.example: The weather service issued a severe storm warning for our area.

words.definition: An alcoholic drink made from fermented grape juice.
words.example: They enjoyed a glass of red wine with their Italian dinner.
